quests.title: Four Hundred Cans
quests.blurb: Friday knock-off in the towers and it rains aluminium up there. Ten cents a can. Four hundred cans is forty dollars. That is not a figure of speech, that is the whole business plan, and the contractor wants it.

steps.label: get up to the plaza outside St Leonards station before the cleaning contractor's van does
the owners corporation have decided the bin room is a security matter. change two minds
forty dollars. four hundred containers. there is no third way to do this
photograph the Royal North Shore car park board. Col is having an argument and needs the evidence
buy the man a flat white. five fifty. fifty-five cans
the machine at St Leonards has been full since Tuesday. take the line up to Artarmon
back down to Col at Wollstonecraft, and let him guess the count

quests.title: The Carport of a Council That No Longer Exists
quests.blurb: Carport in Banksia. Ordered removed in 2015 by Rockdale City Council. Rockdale City Council was abolished in 2016. The order stands, I can't close a file with a live order on it, and the audit is Thursday.

steps.label: collect the notice in triplicate — a second appointment, at the same desk, with the same officer
attend the site: the carport behind the shops off Railway Street, Banksia
photograph the structure from the public footpath, not from the neighbour's yard — the neighbour's yard is a whole other file
doorknock the anonymous complainant, and then the other anonymous complainant
hand-deliver the file to the Rockdale counter. One stop. Council reimburses a fare and not a taxi.

quests.title: The Ninth Floor Still Has My Name On It
quests.blurb: I can't go within a hundred metres of that building until the deed is signed. You can. The foyer directory still has my name on it, three months after they told Fair Work I was never there. Photograph the board.

steps.label: one stop. she would walk it. she can't walk it
buy the coffee first — nobody stands in a North Sydney lobby empty-handed
photograph the foyer directory on Miller Street, ninth floor, her name still on it
one of the pool on the way back, so your camera roll reads like a Tuesday
find your own fare home — her money is held pending a signature
show her the board

quests.title: Make It Look Busy
quests.blurb: Ten fifteen, forty-two Queen Street. You don't have to be buying. I need bodies on the nature strip, and I need them off a train, because the listing says walk to station and I'd like that true in front of the vendor.

steps.label: come in on a train like a buyer would, so the queue starts on the platform
be on the nature strip at forty-two Queen Street by ten fifteen, being demand
shoot the streetscape from the angle that gets the jacaranda in and the servo out
settle two neighbours who came to find out what number fourteen went for and stayed to discuss the drainage
find Deano after the last car pulls out and hear the number

quests.title: The Camry Is Not Missing
quests.blurb: It is not stolen. Stolen is a word for the insurance. Bilal took his uncle's car to Wiley Park at one in the morning and it has been sitting there since with the hazards going.

steps.label: one stop west; she has already timed you
find it three streets back off the park
photograph the wheels before anyone denies them
keep the fella with the straw looking elsewhere
hand the keys back over the counter
